title: Delegation and wait repairs void the stateDiff baseline, costing an alignment broadcast and a stale window per event
outcome: Delegation and wait repairs void the stateDiff baseline, costing an alignment broadcast and a stale window per event
acceptance: Measured after the state-diff landing: the stateBroadcast counters (markedFullStates.alignmentRequest vs diffsEmitted, on GET /api/diagnostics/persistence) over a delegation-heavy window are recorded.

If alignments are a material fraction of cuts, delegation and test-run-wait repairs no longer void the diff baseline on every event: for example a covering HTTP repair keeps the baseline when provably safe, or the repair is answered from a marked cut. This comes with deterministic tests and no loss of the exact-base guarantee.
